meta.title: Grow a Garden crop mutations data

sources.label: Grow a Garden Wiki - Crop Mutations

items.name: Gold
items.obtainment: 1% chance to grow, replacing the normal variant. Chances can be increased by the Pig, Praying Mantis and Bacon Pig pet. Chances can be increased by using Sprinklers. Can be applied by the Super Seed. Only works in crops and not produces. It can increase their produce's chances of being Gold. Can be applied by the Dragonfly, Cockatrice or the Golden Bee pet. Can be applied by the Golden Bee pet when harvesting a crop. Can be applied by using the Gold Fertilizer. Only works in crops and not produces. It can increase their produce's chances of being Gold.
items.visualDescription: Shining. Golden in color. Emits a shimmering sound.

items.name: Rainbow
items.obtainment: 0.1% chance to grow, replacing the normal variant. Chances can be increased by using Pig, Praying Mantis and Bacon Pig pet. Chances can be increased by using Sprinklers. Can be applied by the Super Seed. Only works in crops and not produces. It can increase their produce's chances of being Rainbow. Can be applied by the Butterfly pet when a crop has 5+ environmental mutations. If the Butterfly applies Rainbow this way, all previous mutations will be removed. Can be applied by using the Rainbow Fertilizer. Only works on crops and not produces. It increases the produce's chances of being Rainbow. During Rainbow.
items.visualDescription: Continuously cycles through the colors of the rainbow. Emits yellow particles and a rainbow on top.

items.name: Diamond
items.obtainment: Can be applied by the Diamond Dragonfly pet.
items.visualDescription: Similar to Gold but cyan.

items.name: Wet
items.obtainment: During Rain, Thunderstorm, Under The Sea, Water Your Garden or Rain Dance. Can be applied by Sprinklers. Can be applied by the Sea Turtle or the Kappa pet. Using the Mutation Spray Wet. Can replace Frozen mutation into Wet mutation by the Iguana pet. Can be applied by the Trinity Fruit crop.
items.visualDescription: Dripping water particles.

items.visualDescription: Neon green in color.

items.name: Infected
items.obtainment: During Jandel Zombie.
items.visualDescription: Emits small, hazy green particles. Completely green in color.

items.name: Glitched
items.obtainment: During Dissonant.
items.visualDescription: Fruit becomes semi-transparent with green, teal, blue or white parts. Emits glitch particles nearby.

items.name: Fractured
items.obtainment: Combining Glitched and Plasma mutation.
items.visualDescription: Broken crystal-like appearance.

items.name: Slashbound
items.obtainment: Combining Sliced and Severed mutation.
items.visualDescription: Similar to Severed mutation

items.name: Blackout
items.obtainment: During Reaper Scythe.
items.visualDescription: Fully black in colour, has grey particles.

items.name: Alienlike
items.obtainment: During Alien Invasion or Jandel UFO.
items.visualDescription: Cyan in color Cyan particles emitted from the fruit Parts of fruit can be fully transparent/invisible, or be partially transparent.

items.name: Beanbound
items.obtainment: During Beanaura.
items.visualDescription: The crop is a bright shade of neon green.

items.name: Plagued
items.obtainment: Combining Infected and Zombified mutation.
items.visualDescription: Green mists covers the fruit and admits contagious green particles.

items.name: Touchdown
items.obtainment: During Post Dunk.
items.visualDescription: Red and orange sparkles spray out of the bottom of the fruit.

items.name: Galactic
items.obtainment: During Space Travel or Supernova.
items.visualDescription: Turns the crop a light purple, some parts of the fruit are glowing.

items.name: Extraterrestrial
items.obtainment: Combining Alienlike and Alienated mutation.
items.visualDescription: Blue with black and white and sometime gray.

items.name: Biohazard
items.obtainment: Combining Radioactive and Plagued mutation.
items.visualDescription: Unknown.

items.name: Contagion
items.obtainment: Combining Corrosive and Biohazard mutation.
items.visualDescription: TBA

items.name: Astral
items.obtainment: Combining Cosmic and Galactic mutation.
items.visualDescription: Yellow and pink coloured stars are released and some parts of the fruits are gradient and glowing.

items.name: Charcoal
items.obtainment: Using the Charcoal Sprinkler.
items.visualDescription: Charcoal colour.

items.name: Mineral
items.obtainment: Combining Charcoal, Tempered and Geode mutation.
items.visualDescription: Charcoal but browner.
